network.tdh.explainer.title: How TDH is calculated
network.tdh.explainer.metadataDescriptio: Understand Total Days Held: holding days, edition weights, current boosts and an exact breakdown of your profile’s TDH.
network.tdh.explainer.intro: Total Days Held measures the art you hold and the time you have held it. Each daily snapshot turns whole holding days into a score, using edition weights and a boost for your collection.
network.tdh.explainer.eligible: Base TDH includes The Memes, Gradients and NextGen. Meme Lab and received xTDH are separate.
network.tdh.explainer.reference.title: FirstGM: the original TDH reference
network.tdh.explainer.reference.body: FirstGM (Meme #8) was designed to establish the meaning of one TDH: one copy held for one complete day, before collection boosts. Its open-mint design is central to its role as the original reference card.
network.tdh.explainer.reference.unit: One FirstGM copy × one complete day = one base TDH
network.tdh.explainer.reference.weight: Edition weights put other cards on that scale. The calculator derives rates from the largest eligible effective Meme edition; the exact calculation below explains the supply and floor rules.
network.tdh.explainer.step.days.title: Count whole holding days
network.tdh.explainer.step.days.body: Every copy you still hold contributes its completed days. Two copies held for 100 days contribute 200 holding days. A sale removes the sold copy’s holding history from your score.
network.tdh.explainer.step.weight.title: Apply each card’s edition weight
network.tdh.explainer.step.weight.body: Holding days are multiplied by the card’s HODL rate. Smaller effective editions receive more weight. The rate is rounded to two decimal places before it is used.
network.tdh.explainer.step.boost.title: Apply your collection boost
network.tdh.explainer.step.boost.body: Complete Meme collections, season sets and Gradients can increase your multiplier. It applies to all your eligible holdings. Each token’s boosted contribution is rounded, then added to your total.
network.tdh.explainer.snapshot: Updated daily from the Ethereum block at or just before 00:00 UTC. Processing finishes afterward; the calculation uses the block’s time.
network.tdh.explainer.faq.sale.title: Why can selling one card reduce TDH by more than that card’s score?
network.tdh.explainer.faq.sale.body: The sold copy stops contributing its holding days. If the sale also breaks a set or removes a Gradient boost, your multiplier falls on the rest of your holdings too. TDH is recalculated from what you hold; it is not a permanently banked balance.
network.tdh.explainer.faq.transfer.title: Do I keep my holding time when I move a card?
network.tdh.explainer.faq.transfer.body: Transfers between wallets in your confirmed consolidation preserve the original acquisition time. A transfer outside that group removes the sender’s contribution and starts a new holding period for the recipient. Delegation alone does not consolidate wallets.
network.tdh.explainer.faq.new.title: When does a new purchase or newly minted card count?
network.tdh.explainer.faq.new.body: A copy needs a completed 24-hour holding period to contribute holding days. Newly minted Memes and Gradients also need to pass the snapshot’s separate 24-hour mint-age filter. An already eligible card can complete a set before its new owner has held it for a full day.
network.tdh.explainer.faq.set.title: Does a full collection include the current season?
network.tdh.explainer.faq.set.body: Yes. You need every Meme card eligible for that snapshot, including eligible cards from the current season. When a new card becomes eligible, a previously complete collection may become incomplete. Individual season bonuses follow the eligible seasons listed above.
network.tdh.explainer.faq.rate.title: Why isn’t tomorrow’s change exactly my daily rate?
network.tdh.explainer.faq.rate.body: Daily rate is a guide calculated from positive-age copies and the current boost. Whole-day boundaries, per-token rounding, transfers, new eligible cards and changes in rates or boosts can all affect the next snapshot. The displayed rate may also be rounded down elsewhere in the app.
network.tdh.explainer.faq.xtdh.title: Where does xTDH fit?
network.tdh.explainer.faq.xtdh.body: xTDH is calculated separately. Receiving xTDH does not increase the base TDH explained here. Your TDH rate is an input to the xTDH system.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.intro: Open a step to see the details used by the calculator. Your profile breakdown uses the stored snapshot values, including wallet-level rounding.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.days.title: Holding history and whole days
network.tdh.explainer.exact.days.body: For each surviving copy, take the snapshot block’s timestamp minus its acquisition timestamp, divide by 86,400 seconds, and round down. Only positive whole days enter raw TDH. Transfers are replayed using the current confirmed consolidation group. Outgoing copies are removed from the end of the sending wallet’s acquisition array; after internal transfers this is not always the youngest original acquisition.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.weights.body: To find a Meme’s rate, divide the largest eligible Meme edition by that card’s edition. Both edition counts include any minimum described below. The largest edition can change, so the reference number is not fixed.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.weights.burn: Burning copies normally leaves the minted count used for TDH unchanged, so it does not make the remaining copies earn a higher edition-weighted rate. FirstGM (Meme #8) has one explicit exception: subtract {adjustment} from its {minted} minted copies, giving {adjusted} before applying the edition-size floor. This fixed adjustment does not apply to other burns.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.weights.floo: An edition-size floor is a minimum count used for TDH. If fewer copies were minted, the calculation uses this minimum instead. For example, {minted} minted copies with a floor of {floor} are treated as an edition of {floor}.

For new Memes, the floor is the card’s mint limit or {floor}, whichever is lower. If the mint limit is unavailable, the existing floor is kept, or the card’s supply is used. Older Memes can have different floors.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.weights.rate: Gradients and NextGen use their recorded HODL rates. Every card’s rate is rounded to two decimal places before TDH is calculated.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.rounding.bod: Within each wallet, sum a token ID’s whole holding days, multiply by its rounded rate, round to three decimals, then round to a whole number. Add those already-rounded base values across consolidated wallets. Multiply each consolidated token ID’s base TDH by the current boost and round to a whole number. Sum these final contributions across all three collections.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.rounding.war: Multiplying the grand base total by the boost can give a different answer. So can recomputing base TDH from combined wallet holding days. The profile breakdown below each total keeps the stored base values so the arithmetic can reconcile exactly.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.rounding.for: Final TDH = sum of round(each token’s stored base TDH × boost)
network.tdh.explainer.exact.boost.title: Additional complete sets and boost precision
network.tdh.explainer.exact.boost.body: The first complete collection earns the sum of eligible season bonuses. Each additional complete set adds a smaller bonus: the initial additional-set bonus multiplied by the decay ratio raised to the number of earlier additional sets. The calculator rounds the additional-set sum and the Meme bonus to six decimals, adds the Gradient bonus and baseline, then rounds the final multiplier to two decimals.
network.tdh.explainer.exact.boost.warnin: Current rates and boosts apply to the entire holding history of the copies you still own. The calculation does not accumulate past daily rates or preserve earlier multipliers.
